files.app.yaml:
# podinfo: frontend stack
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: podinfo
  namespace: apps # prod namespace
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: podinfo
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "6.7.1"
  annotations:
    fluxcd.io/automated: "true"
    reloader.stakater.com/auto: "true"
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: podinfo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: podinfo
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: podinfod
          image: ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command:
            - ./podinfo
            - --port=9898
            - --level=info
          env:
            - name: PODINFO_UI_COLOR
              value: "#34577c"
            - name: PODINFO_CACHE
              value: "yes"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 9898
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            limits:
              memory: 256Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
        - name: sidecar
          image: busybox:1.36
          args: ["sleep", "infinity"]
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: podinfo
  namespace: apps
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: podinfo
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 9898
      targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: podinfo-config
  namespace: apps
data:
  version: "1.10"
  enabled: "on"
  config.yaml: |
    server:
      port: 9898
    logLevel: info
  script.sh: |-
    #!/bin/sh
    echo "hello: world"
